annotation.title_clean: 「ロボット農機の公道走行」についての留意事項について
annotation.title_en: Points to Note on "Public Road Driving of Robot Agricultural Machinery"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 警察庁交通局交通企画課長 (National Police Agency, Traffic Planning Division)
annotation.summary_en: Japan National Police Agency circular to prefectural police instructing how to handle public-road operation of robot agricultural machinery under the specific automated operation permit system, road-use permits for remote-type trials, and notification for remotely operated small vehicles, emphasizing streamlined review and reduced burden on farmers.
key_provisions_or_claims: Robot farm machinery with automated operation devices falls under the specific automated operation permit system of the Road Traffic Act.
Police should offer pre-consultation and support to applicants and streamline review of operation plans.
Remote monitoring requirements are relaxed according to traffic environment, allowing tablet terminals.
Public-road autonomous driving verification for road-use permits can be limited to what safety requires.
Remotely operated small vehicle notifications should be simplified, with route maps and documents reduced.
